name: bespokelabsai/kalshi-simulated-ledger-scope-isolation
instr:
We are extending the paper settlement pass (`settlePaperPositions` in `src/commands/paper.ts`) and our reports so the model's paper-simulation positions can be settled without polluting live bankroll metrics or the Brier skill score.

Every settled paper position, old or new, should end up in the `settlements` ledger exactly once as a `ledger_scope = 'PAPER_SIM'` row, booked the way Kalshi books a settled position and keeping the model and market probabilities it had at entry. Our backtest tooling also writes simulated rows straight into `settlements`. Anything that reports or enforces real money must strictly exclude rows where `ledger_scope = 'PAPER_SIM'` or `simulation_run_id` is present, and `summarizeSettlements` should also report `total_stake` (what was paid) and `roi` (as a fraction).

Add an `is_skill_score_eligible` flag that is 1 only for real-money settlements with a yes/no result (in any case) and both entry probabilities. It must be right on every row, even when the tooling inserts or edits rows without setting it, and the tooling's rows must be left as they are. The calibration report's model-vs-market Brier comparison should use only eligible rows, while simulated rows still count in its accuracy breakdown; add `n_simulated` (simulated rows in that breakdown) and `n_skill_eligible` (rows in the comparison).
